# Nature recordings for Slow Days

No music is included in this experience.

- **Ambient Bird Sounds** — isaiah658, CC0 1.0. https://opengameart.org/content/ambient-bird-sounds
  - Source: https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/birds-isaiah658_0.ogg
  - Converted from Ogg to 96 kbps MP3; used with gain changes, short edge fades and looping.
- **Beach Ocean Waves** — jasinski, submitted by qubodup, CC0 1.0. https://opengameart.org/content/beach-ocean-waves
  - Source takes: wave_01_cc0-18363__jasinski__alkaibeach.flac and wave_03_cc0-18363__jasinski__alkaibeach.flac
  - Converted from FLAC to 96 kbps MP3; used with gain changes, short edge fades, layering and looping.

License: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Additional wind and quiet train movement noise are generated in Web Audio from filtered noise. No melody, synthesizer notes, or music tracks are played.
